criteria.labels: PASS: names readable at270px previews, all boxes safe, preserved fade schedule.
criteria.routeObject: PASS: correct path direction and waypoint passage; all current positions match prior admittedV3; reveal never trails object.
criteria.effects: PASS: orange ring expansion visible, cyan path halo remains distinct, scaled trailing echoes visible in encoded detail, destination halo remains through final hold.
criteria.story: PASS: Tokyo introduction, Nagoya passage, Kyoto approach, arrival cue and1second hold.
criteria.V2Comparison: PASS: stronger route/actor contrast, earlier departure, waypoint path, staged destination wording and persistent arrival emphasis visible in direct V2/V3 comparison.
